solution.text:
At 298 K; [H+]=10–7
∴  K w 1 = 10 −14
At 308 K; H+=10–6
∴  K w 2 = 10 −12
Now using
2.303  log 10 Kw 2 Kw 1 = ΔH R T 2 − T 1 T 1 × T 2
2.303  log 10 10 −12 10 −14 = ΔH 2 308−298 298×308
∴   ΔH=84551.4 kcal/mol 
=84.551 kcal/mol
Thus H2O ⇌H++OH-;   ΔH=84.551 kcal/mol
∴   H++OH-⇌H2O;  ΔH-84.551 kcal/mol
